1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not disrupt embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __without prior removal of the embryo from the medium__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __on DNA obtained directly from the shed cellular material without intervening purification steps__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the agitation step is performed for a duration of less than 1 hour__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __sequentially exposing the shed cellular material to cold temperature, then heat, then agitation, wherein the cold temperature is below 10°C and the heat is above 50°C__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least three times__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __sequentially heating the shed cellular material to above 50°C and then agitating__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least three times__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading enzyme that is not a general protease__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __by a method comprising cold and heat treatment followed by agitation, or heating and agitation, or enzymatic digestion__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to isolate the DNA__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at a developmental stage prior to desiccation__.

12. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained directly from the shed cellular material without prior embryo destruction__.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein the phenotyping is correlated with the genotype determined in step (c)__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained directly from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __wherein the selection occurs before germination of the selected embryos__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __immediately after selection based on genotype__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __and wherein the automated selection is performed in a high-throughput format processing at least 96 embryos simultaneously__.
